adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, `comments` is set via `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then `comments.appendChild(iframe)` is called unconditionally. If the host page does not include an element with id `discourse-comments`, `getElementById` returns `null` and `appendChild` will throw, preventing the rest of the script (including attaching the `message` listener) from running.
